title: OrchSLM: Probing the Dynamics of Small Language Model Orchestration
abstract: arXiv:2609.13470v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Although large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities, their reliance on cloud-scale infrastructure poses fundamental challenges for deployment in agentic pipelines, including latency, privacy, connectivity, and substantial computational cost. Small language models (SLMs) offer a compelling alternative: recent studies suggest that many repetitive and narrowly scoped subtasks in agentic workloads may be better served by specialized SLMs than by monolithic LLMs. However, the limited capacity and context windows of SLMs can constrain long-horizon reasoning and interaction-heavy orchestration strategies such as iterative verification and debate. This motivates a complementary, non-interactive paradigm in which heterogeneous SLMs independently generate candidate solutions and a router orchestrates their cached samples without further model interaction. translated_title: OrchSLM：探索小型语言模型编排的动态机制
translated_abstract: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）已展现出卓越的能力，但其对云端规模基础设施的依赖为智能体流水线中的部署带来了根本性挑战，包括延迟、隐私、连接性以及高昂的计算成本。小型语言模型（SLM）提供了一种颇具吸引力的替代方案：近期研究表明，智能体工作负载中许多重复性强、范围狭窄的子任务，由专门的SLM来处理可能比单一的大型LLM更为合适。然而，SLM有限的能力和上下文窗口可能制约长程推理以及迭代验证与辩论等重交互式的编排策略。这激发了一种互补的非交互式范式：由异构的SLM独立生成候选解决方案，并由一个路由器在无需进一步模型交互的情况下对其缓存样本进行编排。为进一步理解此类编排的机制，我们……（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出OrchSLM，探索一种由路由器对多个异构小型语言模型生成的缓存样本进行非交互式编排的范式，以在智能体任务中低成本地替代大型语言模型并揭示其编排动态机制。
en_tdlr: OrchSLM explores a non-interactive orchestration paradigm in which a router coordinates cached candidate solutions from heterogeneous small language models, offering a low-cost alternative to LLMs for agentic tasks and probing the dynamics of such SLM orchestration.
